mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 1.0%) compresses equity discount rates by reducing the risk-free rate, increasing the present value of future corporate cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
